title: The Shaded Park Bench  (O Banco de Parque Sombreado)

segments.t: Sob as árvores frondosas no tranquilo jardim público no final da Rua Linden, {Hannah}, {Caleb} e {Arthur} se reúnem ao redor de um banco verde de madeira para ler o quarto e último cartão em aquarela. Vamos ouvir primeiro.
Ah, a comfortable wooden bench in the shade—my feet approve of Clue Four!
Listen to the final rhyme: Sit in the shade and bring all four corners home together.
Bring all four corners together... hand me Cards One, Two, and Three, {Hannah}!
Wait—look at the faint blue lines drawn along the outer edges of each card!
Turn them face up on the flat bench slat like four tiles of one square...
Card One top left, Card Two top right, Card Three bottom left, Card Four bottom right!
Incredible! Together the four backs form a bird-eye drawing of Linden Courtyard Inn!
There is our courtyard tree, there are the arched windows of Room Nine...
And look up on the second-floor wooden courtyard balcony—a bright red painted star!
Why did the mapmaker paint a red star on our upstairs courtyard balcony?!
Perhaps the small wax-sealed envelope in your pocket has the answer, {Hannah}!
We walked every clue honestly—even {Arthur} and his extra circle—so let us open it!
Agora vamos repassar a conversa com calma, frase por frase.
Ah, a comfortable wooden bench in the shade—my feet approve of Clue Four!
'Ah, um confortável banco de madeira na sombra — meus pés aprovam a Pista Quatro!'
Listen to the final rhyme: Sit in the shade and bring all four corners home together.
'Ouça a última rima: Sente-se na sombra e traga todos os quatro cantos juntos de volta para casa.'
Bring all four corners together... hand me Cards One, Two, and Three, {Hannah}!
'Traga todos os quatro cantos juntos... me passe os Cartões Um, Dois e Três, Hannah!'
Wait—look at the faint blue lines drawn along the outer edges of each card!
'Esperem — olhem para as fracas linhas azuis desenhadas ao longo das bordas externas de cada cartão!'
Turn them face up on the flat bench slat like four tiles of one square...
'Vire-os com a face para cima na ripa reta do banco como quatro azulejos de um quadrado...'
Card One top left, Card Two top right, Card Three bottom left, Card Four bottom right!
'Cartão Um no topo esquerdo, Cartão Dois no topo direito, Cartão Três no canto inferior esquerdo, Cartão Quatro no canto inferior direito!'
Incredible! Together the four backs form a bird-eye drawing of Linden Courtyard Inn!
'Incrível! Juntos, os quatro versos formam um desenho em vista aérea do Pousada do Pátio da Tília!'
There is our courtyard tree, there are the arched windows of Room Nine...
'Lá está a nossa árvore do pátio, lá estão as janelas em arco do Quarto Nove...'
And look up on the second-floor wooden courtyard balcony—a bright red painted star!
'E olhe para cima na varanda de madeira do segundo andar do pátio — uma estrela pintada de vermelho brilhante!'
Why did the mapmaker paint a red star on our upstairs courtyard balcony?!
'Por que o cartógrafo pintou uma estrela vermelha na nossa varanda do pátio no andar de cima?!'
Perhaps the small wax-sealed envelope in your pocket has the answer, {Hannah}!
'Talvez o pequeno envelope lacrado com cera no seu bolso tenha a resposta, Hannah!'
We walked every clue honestly—even {Arthur} and his extra circle—so let us open it!
'Nós andamos todas as pistas honestamente — até o Arthur e o círculo extra dele — então vamos abri-lo!'
Vamos ouvir toda a cena novamente em velocidade natural.

Listen to the final rhyme: Sit in the shade and bring all four corners home together.
Bring all four corners together... hand me Cards One, Two, and Three, {Hannah}!
Wait—look at the faint blue lines drawn along the outer edges of each card!
Turn them face up on the flat bench slat like four tiles of one square...
Card One top left, Card Two top right, Card Three bottom left, Card Four bottom right!
Incredible! Together the four backs form a bird-eye drawing of Linden Courtyard Inn!
There is our courtyard tree, there are the arched windows of Room Nine...
And look up on the second-floor wooden courtyard balcony—a bright red painted star!
Why did the mapmaker paint a red star on our upstairs courtyard balcony?!
Perhaps the small wax-sealed envelope in your pocket has the answer, {Hannah}!
We walked every clue honestly—even {Arthur} and his extra circle—so let us open it!
Colocados lado a lado no banco de parque sombreado, os quatro cartões se unem em um mapa secreto do Pousada do Pátio da Tília coroado com uma estrela vermelha brilhante. Até a próxima.
See you soon!
